notes.title: Version 1.3 Update + Traditional Chinese Localization!
notes.content:
In this update, Traditional Chinese is now supported!

You can change the language by right click on "Journey On" in your Steam Library, select "Properties" then "Language".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40753389/f9a306deedf2d1114c8d8de856ec4c556b4ff367.png

v1.3 Fixed Bugs:
-Some of the in-game text for the equipments are cut off.
-Sometimes Shirley may not revive after a boss battle.
-Some equipments don't inflict status ailments correctly.
-Examine indicators displayed incorrectly.
-In-game message color displays incorrectly.

v1.3 Gameplay Changes:
-"Demonic Fruit" drop rate increase.
-"Abyss Worm" and "Dark Mistress" Max HP reduce.
-In-Game text change for the tutorial.
-Enemies movement change during the conversation.

Found any bugs? Please let us know! 
Bug report thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1493560/discussions/0/3090023948251812414/

notes.title: v1.2 Update
notes.content:
Hello! In this update we fixed a few bugs, and changed how the mouse over selection works in battles. This should fix the issue that sometimes a target can't be changed because of the mouse cursor position.

Fixed Bugs:
-In-game text with incorrect information or grammar error.
-Examine indicators displayed incorrectly.
-Divine property on a weapon did not work.
-”Call Spirit” can be used on a dead body in the Experiment Room without required MP.

Gameplay Changes:
-We changed how mouse over selection in battle works.

If you are running into issues, you can submit a bug report here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1493560/discussions/

notes.title: Version Update v1.1
notes.content:
Fixed Bugs:
1) Darkness Sanctuary map name may display incorrectly if players upgrade the power without watching cutscenes from the past.

Gameplay changes:
1) Mind Blast from Cerberus is now single target.
2) Summon spirit Queen Natalia is now stronger.
3) Magic description text change.

notes.title: Version Update: v1.0.9
notes.content:
Fixed Bugs:
1) Fixed the bug that spirits can be hit with certain status ailments.
2) Fixed character position error in after guardian fight cutscenes.

Gameplay changes:
1) Abomination of Agony's attack boost status and "Endless Pain" move now has a cooldown.
2) Additional hint to defeat Abomination of Agony boss fight.
2) Text description for skills and equipments has been changed.

notes.title: Version Update: v1.0.8
notes.content:
Fixed Bugs:
1) In Beastmen's Village, players can pick up some items from the incorrect direction.
2) Fixed spirit summon animation in Ruins of Elendia. 
3) Map name display incorrectly in Darkness Sanctuary.

Gameplay changes:
1) Additional door cutscenes will play after 3 guardians fight.

notes.title: Version Update: v1.0.7
notes.content:
Fixed Bugs:
1) Sometimes the cutscene from the past won't play.
2) Examine indicator display incorrectly in Shirley's room.
3) Pick Up indicator display incorrectly in Keld Village.
4) Fixed the text from a book.

Gameplay Changes:
1) More hints on how "Dark Affinity" works.
2) More hints on how to bypass the first phase of the final boss fight for one ending.

Please relaunch your Steam client to receive the update.

notes.title: Version Update: v1.0.6
notes.content:

notes.content:
